https://github.com/mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis/blob/cf97c32fec1b2e96e9936746e2731a81bd5ea33f/.verify/report-2026-07-30-v2.json (anonymous probe 2026-07-30: gpt-oss-120b and Qwen3-Coder-30B -> 429 {"message":"API rate limit exceeded","request_id":...} after ~40 s)
notes: Status and limits documented; body community. The flat {message, request_id} is a gateway (Kong-style) shape, not OpenAI's. Anonymous traffic has no key: per-IP per-model, nothing to rotate. With a key the counter is per Public Cloud project per model (paid). The 429 arrived after ~40 s of latency in the probe.

sources: https://github.com/mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis/blob/cf97c32fec1b2e96e9936746e2731a81bd5ea33f/.verify/report-2026-07-30-v2.json (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -> 404 with this exact body)
notes: Two envelopes on one host: OpenAI-shaped 404 from the inference backend vs flat gateway 429.

body.message: Requests per minute limit exceeded - too many requests sent.

message_template: Requests per minute limit exceeded - too many requests sent.
sources: https://github.com/nminaya/grammar-nazi-bot/issues/959 (2026-08-12 capture: {"message":"Requests per minute limit exceeded - too many requests sent.","type":"too_many_requests_error","param":"quota","code":"request_quota_exceeded"})
https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/support/rate-limits.md ('Rate limits apply at the organization level, not the user level, and vary based on the model'; token bucketing 'replenishes continuously')
https://github.com/nathabonfim59/cerebras-code-monitor/blob/27ee6c12e229026eab5b23f84b36299304f0ecea/README.md (header list; reset headers in seconds)
notes: FLAT envelope - no 'error' wrapper, the four fields sit at the root. Without retry-after: 20s unsized throttle (the bucket refills continuously, so a short probe is right). Organization-level per model: other keys of the same org share the counter.

body.message: Tokens per minute limit exceeded - too many tokens processed.

message_template: Tokens per minute limit exceeded - too many tokens processed.
sources: https://github.com/navyaravuri/nexusml/blob/fc9286804b64641314b7ee0c9417fe17ea949a0c/logs/agent_comms.log ('Error code: 429 - {'message': 'Tokens per minute limit exceeded - too many tokens processed.', 'type': 'too_many_tokens_error', 'param': 'quota', 'code': 'token_quota_exceeded'}')

https://github.com/olliegilbey/nalu/blob/eba1b4370041539965431d1f3b92f14c1f82e4a3/src/lib/llm/cerebrasRateLimit.ts ('x-ratelimit-reset-tokens-minute, which Cerebras sends as SECONDS-UNTIL-RESET (a floating-point number, e.g. 11.38)'; no per-day token header)
https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/support/rate-limits.md ('A 429 error will indicate which bucket was exceeded' - uncached vs total TPM)
notes: The same code token_quota_exceeded is used for the DAY counter (next row): only the message prefix ('per minute' vs 'per day') separates them. The doc says the message names the uncached vs total bucket, but no capture shows that wording yet. Note: some clients misread this as context-length (the nexusml log labels it 'Context window exceeded') - it is not. Float seconds: the single parser must accept a decimal (R16).

body.message: Tokens per day limit exceeded - too many tokens processed.

message_template: Tokens per day limit exceeded - too many tokens processed.
sources: https://github.com/map1404/agentic-drift-detection/blob/fe72c7017dc63ac47ae7205aece28fec4672a609/outputs/favorita_run_llm_agent.log ('daily_quota: {"message":"Tokens per day limit exceeded - too many tokens processed.","type":"too_many_tokens_error","param":"quota","code":"token_quota_exceeded"} | headers={'retry-after': '86400'}')

https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/support/rate-limits.md (Free Trial: 1M TPH and 1M TPD per model; 'Hourly and daily restrictions don't apply to Developer (Pay as You Go)'; token bucketing replenishes continuously)
notes: The response STATES 86400 s; stated outranks derived (R12) and the ceiling caps it at 3600 (one probe per hour). Not the Gemini PerDay carve-out: there the stated number is known-false (R06); here it is a literal full day on a continuously-refilling bucket, so the hourly probe may find capacity earlier. The Free Trial also has a TPH (1M/hour) counter whose message wording was not found.

body.message: We're experiencing high traffic right now! Please try again soon.

message_template: We're experiencing high traffic right now! Please try again soon.
sources: https://github.com/EdonFetaji/GCA-RAG/blob/10233413c5b878b7e07f9811f4a9d0af8bd7b538/data/training/clean/_failures.jsonl (2026-08-13: '429 - {'message': "We're experiencing high traffic right now! Please try again soon.", 'type': 'too_many_requests_error', 'param': 'queue', 'code': 'queue_exceeded'}')

https://github.com/CAR-bench/car-bench-ijcai/blob/fe977fb00b4ddf10c9b42218c67f3b218aa452a1/docs/cerebras-harness-patterns.md ('queue_exceeded with param: "queue" ... means the provider queue is saturated. If Cerebras sends retry-after, the template respects it')
notes: Same 429 + same type as the RPM throttle; param='queue' / code='queue_exceeded' is the only separator. Capacity fact, never escalates (R20). If retry-after is present, obey it (capped 3600).

sources: https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/support/error.md (status table: '402 | PaymentRequired')
https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/support/rate-limits.md (Free Trial: $5 credits that expire 30 days after grant; 'API and Playground access stop on the Free Trial tier until you purchase credits')
https://github.com/Mikecranesync/MIRA/issues/3711 (observed 'Client error 402 Payment Required' from Cerebras in production, body not shown)
notes: End of the one-time trial (credits used or 30 days passed) - it will not renew. The Python SDK has no named class for 402 (falls to APIStatusError), same as openai-python.

rest_rule: auth: 300s, then 3600 after two refuted re-probes

https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/support/error.md ('403 | PermissionDeniedError')
notes: Cause not documented; Dedicated-only model families would be a plausible trigger (inference).
